description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'InvalidInstanceTypeMethodException' used in the Fineract platform, specifically for handling invalid method calls related to instance types within the security exception package.

classes.name: InvalidInstanceTypeMethodException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating an invalid method was used for a particular instance type in the platform.

methods.name: InvalidInstanceTypeMethodException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the invalid method name and a message indicating the error.
